summary: PMV Pharmaceuticals filed a routine Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to disclose updated interim clinical data, not a special situation. On August 31, 2026, the company reported a 46% overall response rate among 76 evaluable patients in the ovarian cancer cohort of the Phase 2 pivotal PYNNACLE trial of rezatapopt monotherapy, with median duration of response of 10.0 months at a May 14, 2026 cutoff. A recent FDA interaction supports an NDA submission for accelerated approval in platinum-resistant/refractory ovarian cancer planned for Q1 2027. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
